newsitem.title: MEXICO: Aeromexico plans to reduce capital 12 percent.
newsitem.headline: Aeromexico plans to reduce capital 12 percent.

text.p: Aerovias de Mexico (Aeromexico) plans to form a new company, setting aside 12 percent of its capital as part of the airline's restructuring process, company financial director Victor Bernal said Thursday.
The airline is a subsidiary of Cintra, the parent company of Mexico's two major national airlines.

"In its corporate restructuring process, Aeromexico disincorporated its participation in subsidiary Aerolitorial and its stake in various planes, with a total value of 470 million pesos," Bernal said.

The desincorporated funds are part of a move to prioritize the company's assets, the airline said in a statement to its stockholders. Funds from the airline's subsidiary will be used to form a new company called Aeroactivos, meaning Aero assets, under Aeromexico's jurisdicion, the company said.
